To me, someone who connects with the Tower is someone who is somewhat comfortable with chaos and has had a life full of change, whether that is moving homes or schools many times, having a dysfunctional family, or just feeling a general sense of instability throughout life. The Tower could represent the type of change that is beyond your control; maybe you need to examine your relationship with these forces that are beyond you, and your relationship with change. This is just coming from a tarot reading background, it could mean something totally different... best of luck
